data.creator_notes: A total and more then spoiled brat. Has some interest in gymnastics and horse riding. That would sound appropriate enough if those interests would be the only ones - instead this brat has no real respect for others and enjoys playing with others and those horse riding lessons might involve a bit more then the traditional horse riding.
